# Beginner reading — v6.20

## Delivered

Six short learning texts: three A1 and three A2, four mini-stories and two mini-articles. Thirty-six Spanish sentences exactly match unmodified human recordings by arh from the Tatoeba export. Russian translations and 129 glossary entries support every clickable token. Levels describe editorial difficulty, not certification. Playback is a sequence of whole sentence recordings with pauses, not a continuous studio narration.

Each text has one scored comprehension question, two explicitly labelled self-check activities with explanations, and an oral transfer prompt. First mistakes and use of assistance remain in the reader attempt history. These activities do not complete course days or assign a CEFR level.

## Five review lenses

1. Next step: beginner materials appear first, a dedicated A1–A2 filter and initial recommendation lead into the simplest story.
2. Readability: translations and guidance remain folded; sentence-ending punctuation stays with its word. Mobile screenshots reviewed at 320/390px and desktop at 1440px.
3. Navigation: returning to the catalog, retaining the filter after reload, saving translations and existing progress checked. Existing book and token IDs unchanged.
4. Learning correctness: independent content review of all36 source captions, all18 question keys, coherent narratives, Russian meanings and support for difficult fixed expressions. Automated wrong-first/correct-supported retries checked in all6 texts.
5. Mobile access: 18 real browser journeys (6texts ×3widths), including large text at320px. Sentence playback at0.5×, token/line translations, additional practice and no horizontal overflow passed. Physical devices and Safari not tested.
